text_block_list.text:
While training
with Silence Suzuka—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —There you are, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Air Groove... What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yeah. The student council was holding an orientation for the underclassmen, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"They wouldn't stop pestering me
about wanting to meet you at least once."

Behind Air Groove, a number of underclassmen
were watching Silence Suzuka with rapt attention.

text_block_list.name: Junior A
text_block_list.text: Waaah, it really is Suzuka-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Junior B
text_block_list.text:
You mean that "Great Front-Runner" girl, right?
So cool~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y-You know who I am...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. There are plenty of juniors
who look up to you now.

text_block_list.name: Junior A
text_block_list.text:
Um, Suzuka-senpai!
If it's okay with you, would you run with me!?

text_block_list.name: Junior B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no fair!
I want you to teach me how to run as a Front Runner too~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait, hold on.
Suzuka is in the middle of training right now—
choice_data_list: If it's just a little, that should be fine.
If it's just a bit, I think that's fine.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Mmhââ

I explained that helping with the coaching
would also be beneficial for Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
――Understood.
Though I'm not sure if I'm up to the task...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
But... um, Trainer.
...Where should we start?
choice_data_list: Starting with how to run away...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"A tandem run—yes.
I excel at running."

text_block_list.name: Junior A
text_block_list.text:
Really?
Yay! I look forward to working with you~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Suzuka. Just to make sure,
don't you dare go running for real, okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Listen up. Be absolutely certain, okay? You understand?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm alright now.
It's just running, so don't worry so much."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No, it's just running, which is why I'm worried—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
......Very well.
I shall entrust it to you for now.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's go.
Ready... set... go...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —Phew.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...?
Wanna run together, Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No. Why did you leave your training partner behind
and run multiple laps all by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I told you beforehand
not to run all out."

text_block_list.name: Junior A
text_block_list.text:
No! I'm just so happy to be able
to watch you run up close like this, Suzuka-san...!

text_block_list.name: Junior B
text_block_list.text:
Yes!! We'll do our best to keep up,
so please show us more and more!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah...
Umm—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Air Groove, what should we do...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, yeah.
As long as they're happy with it, that's fine by me."

Even after that, I watched over Silence Suzuka
as her juniors gazed at her with eyes full of admiration.

text_block_list.name: Junior B
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
To think I'd get taught by Suzuka-san...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Instruction...? Um, well...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Take it one step at a time. Suzuka,
what's the very first thing you think about at the start?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Like... just wanting to have a nice, pleasant run?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...What happened after that?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Run and run... and after that,
one final push to the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
My mistake for trying to have you explain it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "Huh...? Why?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Listen. Once you take the lead,
you must control the pace of those behind you yourself—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I see. It's quite difficult, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Why are YOU the one being impressed?!

text_block_list.name: Junior B
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
I'll be sure to try it right away next time!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That was very easy to understand.
You really are amazing, Air Groove...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Honestly. That was covered in our race strategy classes, you know.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even if you don't use it yourself,
there's no harm in keeping the theory in mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"After all, I can't say there won't ever be an occasion
where I'll have to teach someone like this."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...Um, if you don't mind, Air Groove,
please tell me more next time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: âHo. So you've said it, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Then, to help improve your grades,
I will hold an intensive lecture session soon.
choice_data_list: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh?
Um, Trainer...?"
Later on, Silence Suzuka's grades reportedly improved thanks to Air Groove's intensive tutoring.
